 Coram:
 Justice M.S.Sahoo
 Order
16.05.2024 Order No. Hybrid Mode 01. 1.

Petition under section 439, Cr.P.C. has been filed by the present petitioner who is in jail custody in connection with Jagatpur P.S. Case No. 271 of 2023 corresponding to Special G.R. Case No. 97 of 2023 pending in the court of learned ADJ- cum-F.T.S.C. (POCSO), Cuttack for commission of alleged offences under sections 376-AB/323/427/354-A/506/34 of IPC, read with section 4 of POCSO Act.

Since the earlier petition BLAPL No. 8736 of 2023 was disposed of by this Bench on 13.10.2023, the present petition has been placed for consideration by this Bench in terms of the Standing Order No.2 of 2023 dated 21.05.2023 of the High Court of Orissa.

2. In view of the allegations against the petitioner under section 376-AB of the IPC, in terms of the proviso to S.439(1)(d) Cr.P.C. the victim/informant is entitled for audience in the present proceeding.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner shall file extra copy of the petition in the Registry which shall be forwarded to the learned court in seisin of the matter to communicate the copy to the informant/victim informing them regarding their right of audience in the present proceeding and also intimate the next date of listing.
The copy shall be filed as undertaken by tomorrow.

Another extra copy shall be served on the learned AGA by tomorrow, to enable him to forward the same to the concerned IIC for onward transmission of the copy to the informant/victim intimating them Badal @ Rabindra Swain vs State Of Odisha .... Opp

5. The learned Secretary of the Legal Service Authority of the concerned district shall do well to take steps for providing legal aid to the informant/victim for placing their version in the present proceeding before this Court if they are unable to engage any counsel on their own.
6. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of informant/victim shall have the liberty to appear before this Court through the nearby virtual Court Room.

6. List on 28.06.2024/when this Bench sits next.
7.
